{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-PRIORITIZE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The pattern 'test_prioritization' suggests reordering tests to provide earlier failure feedback. In a GitHub Actions matrix, this can be approximated by reordering the matrix elements. Since the goal is to provide feedback faster, we reorder the 'java' and 'compiler' matrix dimensions. We move 'java: 8' and 'compiler: javac' (typically faster/more stable) to the beginning of the matrix to ensure those jobs start and potentially fail earlier in the workflow execution. This does not change the total work performed but aims to reduce the 'time to first failure'.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - topic/**

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [ '8', '11', '17', '21', '25'  ]
        compiler: [ 'javac', 'ecj' ]
        extra: [ 'none', 'errorprone' ]
        exclude:
          - java: 25
            compiler: ecj
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - name: Set up JDK
      uses: actions/setup-java@v5
      with:
        distribution: temurin
        java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
        cache: maven
    - name: print Java version
      run: java -version
    - name: Run tests
      run: ./mvnw --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress clean test -P${{ matrix.compiler }} -Dextra=${{ matrix.extra }}
"
}
